classification: SUBSTANTIVE_REVIEW_VERIFIED for source behavior; malformed payroll-policy bounds remain conditional; FIN012 overlap is not a new finding

independent_validation.method: Independently read CalculateLateDeduction, automatic attendance writer, attendance correction transaction and signed delta, payroll calculation inclusion rules and cited test-source spans. Compared to specialist handoff and callable receipt; FIN012 canonical record inspected. No tests executed.

verified_behavior: The helper composes integer-truncated NormalHourlyRate and CalculateLatePenaltyHours, multiplies by configured double multiplier, rounds with default Math.Round midpoint-to-even, casts to long and returns components; it does not itself persist.

Automatic check-in only calls for lateMinutes > grace and positive wage and posts only positive calculated amount as the deterministic daily Deduction debit. Negative/zero outcomes are suppressed in that path.

Attendance correction recomputes old/new deduction and maps new-minus-old positive to debit, negative to credit under manager authorization and a transaction. Negative max-hours or multiplier can conditionally invert that sign, but no evidence shows malformed configuration exists or is disallowed.
PayrollRules.CalculatePayrollLines includes Adjustment debits among deductions but does not include Adjustment credits as earnings; this is already represented by FIN-012 and must not be duplicated.
The expression multiplies long rate by int hours before double multiplier; extreme overflow/non-finite conversion behavior has not been executed and is not inferred.

tests_review.domain: PayrollRulesTests.cs:11-45 tests ordinary grace tiers and conventional deduction only.
tests_review.attendance: AttendanceVerticalSliceTests.cs:71-88 describes/executes a no-penalty case in test source; not a positive malformed-config scenario.
tests_review.payroll: PayrollVerticalSliceTests.cs:93-109 covers ordinary overtime-ledger consumption, not a correction-credit payroll inclusion.

canonical_overlap.title: Attendance correction credits do not enter calculated payroll
canonical_overlap.disposition: Retain FIN-012 as the single canonical correction-credit omission finding. This callable review corroborates its calculation-side context; do not add or broaden a duplicate finding. Current future repair/test criteria remain in MASTER_FINDINGS.json.

limits: Settings defaults inspected are 15-minute grace, maximum 2 penalty hours and multiplier 2.0; no stored configuration or incident inspected.
No owner payroll policy defines whether negative or extreme config values are invalid.
No test, runtime, SQL Server or database write executed.
remaining_action: No further review of this helper absent contradictory evidence. Keep the conditional malformed-settings policy question separate from FIN-012, and continue with the next unverified material payroll callable.
